Da quale organo nasce la massa? Descrivi: Which organ does the mass arise from? Describe it and indicate what should be looked for in staging.
Per capire da dove nasce una grande mass:
To work out where a large abdominal mass arises from, look for: the beak sign (the organ wraps around the mass with acute margins), the "phantom organ" sign (the organ of origin is no longer seen separately), the vessels feeding it (here renal branches) and displacement of adjacent organs.
In clear cell renal carcinoma the mass is hypervascular, heterogeneous, with necrosis. For TNM staging you need: size (T1 ≤ 7 cm, T2 > 7 cm), invasion of perirenal fat or sinus (T3a), thrombus in the renal vein (T3a) or in the cava (T3b below the diaphragm, T3c above), ipsilateral adrenal gland, lymph nodes, metastases (lung, bone, contralateral adrenal gland, brain).
In this patient the collection reports pT3 and M1: the surgery was a cytoreductive nephrectomy. The metastases are not in the field of view of this CT: for this reason complete staging requires chest CT.
